_comment: ACT per-role config. Move to ~/.act.json (NOT repo root). Each agent specifies a provider (key under "providers") and a model string passed verbatim to the upstream API. ACT does not maintain a list of supported models — type the upstream identifier as-is.

groq._comment: Free tier with Llama 3.3 70B is great for swarm. Get a key at https://console.groq.com

openrouter._comment: Aggregator with many free models. Get a key at https://openrouter.ai

local._comment: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint. baseURL points at LM Studio (default), Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), vLLM, etc. apiKey is usually empty for local.

agents._comment: Tier 1 = Planner / Observer / Assurance / QA. Tier 2 = swarm developer / frontend_dev / backend_dev / qa_engineer / researcher.

observer._comment: Mid-tier. Watchdog, only fires on anomalies.

developer._comment: Default swarm. backend=claude-code uses your Claude Code subscription instead of API tokens.
